# Gymbo

> Gymbo is a business app for independent personal trainers in India. It turns the day-to-day of running a training practice into a few taps: punching classes, recording payments, checking balances, scheduling, and looking professional. Start free, then Pro is monthly or annual, paid on the web. No plan has a client limit.

Gymbo is built for the independent personal trainer, not a gym chain or dietitian. A trainer's day is classes, schedules, and payments, so Gymbo is built around that: punch a class in a couple of taps, let the client card calculate the balance, and see in red who owes you classes, with a warning when a balance runs low. Gymbo also includes a daily email summary, workout builder, Ask Gymbo, and a shareable QR profile card. Clients do not download anything. Gymbo is for the trainer.

## Key features

- Class punches in a couple of taps, with automatic balance math
- Payment and balance tracking (cash or UPI), reminders you send yourself
- Scheduling and your full client roster in one place
- Workout builder with a template library (build and assign workouts)
- A shareable QR profile card and branded PDF statements
- Sign in with your phone, Apple, or Google

## Pricing

- Free: ₹0. Sign up, view and export your clients' records.
- Pro, monthly: ₹399/month
- Pro, annual: ₹2,999 per year (₹250/month effective, save 37%)
- Pro is paid on the web with Razorpay. There is no trial.
